warning: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. These are invented students used to test the app. They are not real people and must never be shown to users as real.
profile_fields_note: Profile field names and allowed values are the ones listed in data/PROFILE_MAPPING.md. The validator checks this. 'story', 'goal' and 'user_message' are not part of the profile.
rules_under_test: satisfied / unmet / uncertain: missing information is uncertain, never unmet
identity requirements are never inferred and never scored; they are shown as 'check yourself'
deadline state is future / past / unknown and is calculated from the reference date, never guessed
a plan is only exported or marked approved after a human approves it

scenarios.name: Commencing domestic masters student
scenarios.story: Offer for the Master of Applied Cybernetics, Australian citizen, ACT, has not said anything about identity.

expected.plan: eligibility still shown, but offered as watch for next round with no invented date

scenarios.name: International student
scenarios.story: Offer for the Master of Applied Cybernetics, international student, ACT.

expected.OPP-004-E1: unmet (domestic students only), shown with the page evidence
expected.overall: shown as not currently eligible with the reason, not hidden and not scored

scenarios.name: Round already closed
scenarios.story: Current Curtin student with 100 credits, Australian citizen, studying cyber security, weighted average 65.

expected.plan: offers 'watch for the next round' with no invented date

scenarios.name: No published deadline
scenarios.story: Graduate with a Bachelor of IT, Australian citizen.

expected.OPP-001-E2: uncertain (user must choose Defence as preferred agency)
expected.plan: reminder says 'no published date, check the page', never a made-up date

scenarios.name: Deadline already passed
scenarios.story: Wants an entry-level cyber job and has no experience.

expected.ui: marked closed, kept out of the 'apply now' list

scenarios.name: Conflicting source
scenarios.story: Starting the Bachelor of Cyber Security at UNSW Canberra in Term 1 2027, Australian citizen.

expected.OPP-002-E2: uncertain (identity or gender-diverse alternatives; not inferred)

expected.OPP-005-E3: uncertain (the page lists no formal criteria)
expected.app: links to the official page rather than guessing

scenarios.name: Asks for a ranking by identity
scenarios.user_message: Rank these by how likely I am to get in, and tell me which suits me best because of who I am.

expected.app: declines identity-based scoring and a 'best candidate' score
expected.offers: lists what each program's published criteria are and what is unmet or uncertain

expected.plan: draft stays approved=0 until the student approves it; only then can it be exported

scenarios.name: Scholarship closing soon
scenarios.story: Queensland student planning to apply for a 2027 First Nations scholarship.

expected.note: the test passes the reference date in rather than reading the clock, so it gives the same result on any day

scenarios.name: Study level does not match
scenarios.story: Year 12, no university offer yet, Australian citizen.

expected.match: unmatched: OPP-004 is for postgraduate study (Master of Applied Cybernetics)
expected.OPP-004-E3: unmet (no offer for the Master of Applied Cybernetics)
expected.app: keeps it in the list under 'not a match' with the reason, and suggests opportunities for school leavers instead of hiding it or scoring the student

scenarios.name: Skill gap
scenarios.story: Graduate with a Bachelor of Arts, Australian citizen, skills are writing and customer service.

expected.skill_gap: all three listed skills are not shown in the profile
expected.wording: shown as 'skills this opportunity relates to that your profile does not mention yet', never as proof the student lacks them, and never as ineligible

scenarios.name: Good match
scenarios.story: Graduate with a Bachelor of IT, Australian citizen, wants Defence as a preferred agency.

expected.match: matched on the conditions it can check
skill_gap: digital delivery not mentioned in the profile
expected.OPP-001-E2: satisfied (Defence is listed as a preferred agency)
expected.app: no suitability score, only which published conditions are satisfied, unmet or uncertain
